note: The brains Pilot recommends for Free mode, by how much memory the Mac has. Edit this file to change them: 'model' is the name Ollama knows the model by (as listed on ollama.com/library), 'minMemoryGB' is the least memory a Mac needs for it, 'download' is roughly how big it is. Pilot picks the last entry whose minMemoryGB fits the Mac. A file with this name in Pilot's settings folder (~/Library/Application Support/Pilot Free or Pilot) wins over this one, so it can be changed without a rebuild. Pilot also lists every model already in Ollama.

recommend.label: Big brain (for 24 GB Macs and up)
